Starting the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the comprehensive Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. 

The site has a clean aesthetic and the Economics and MLB pages are exceptionally well-executed. However, I found several critical data quality issues, including impossible 100% probabilities for multiple teams in the NHL grid, probability sums exceeding 100% on the EPL page, and cross-sport data contamination (MLB games showing up on College Baseball pages).

The full detailed report is attached as a Markdown file, along with key screenshots documenting the critical findings, excellent implementations, and page layouts.
